description: The bar chart compares the Token Ratio (TR) performance of three models across six categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick intervals of 0.1. Each category contains three bars representing RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), respectively. Notably, SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 consistently outperforms the other models across all categories, achieving a perfect score of 1.00 in each case. RedWhale demonstrates a steady improvement across the datasets, with its highest performance observed in KoBEST-SN (approximately 0.73). In contrast, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 shows a decline in performance from KoBEST-BQ to KoBEST-HS, where it achieves its lowest score of 0.50. On average, RedWhale slightly surpasses EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, with a mean score of 0.61 compared to 0.57.
